description:
The goods 

 Are you better at writing software than you are at writing to your mom?  Do you sometimes catch a glimpse of how beautiful code can be?  Would you consider yourself a tinkerer? How about a life-long learner?

 If you’ve recently finished your comp sci degree, and you’re ready to make stuff for real, if you’ve done some projects with Node and React and want to get deeper, if you want to join a young, fun team who aim to do it right, we might have the perfect role for you.

 As a junior developer, you’ll be an integral part of the team working on the full stack of Gradient’s core products. You’ll work alongside the rest of the team, taking on increasingly complex tasks and growing every day.


 We have 

 
 A cause that we're passionate about driving and sharing

 A team of aces to learn from and collaborate with

 A stylin’ stack: React, Nest, Node, Typescript, AWS, MongoDB

 An open mind for new ideas and methodologies

 A scrappy start-up attitude and plans for world domination

 
 You have 

 
 A computer science degree or equivalent

 At least one personal project we can look at

 Some history with Typescript or JavaScript

 Dedicated to diligence. Bonus points for including "Diligence Dynamo "as one of your core skills… show us you can read through our fluff

 Experience developing with AI

 Endless curiosity, a love of learning and a growth mindset

 
 


 Extra Awesomeness 

 
 Experience developing in Typescript (or Javascript) on Node.js in the public cloud (preferably AWS)? Wild!

 Experience with CircleCI, Playwright? Nice!

 Experience building with AI? Ollama!
